promptDecks.title: Introductions & First Impressions
promptDecks.grammarFocus: to be + adjectives (I am from… / It is interesting)

promptDecks.title: Work & Career Choices
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Present simple for routines (I work… / She doesn’t work…)

promptDecks.title: Time Management & Daily Priorities
promptDecks.grammarFocus: What time…? / I usually… at…

promptDecks.title: Family Roles & Responsibilities
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Have got / has got (I’ve got two brothers. She’s got three children.)

promptDecks.title: Appearance & First Judgments
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Adjectives to describe people (He looks… / She dresses…)

promptDecks.title: Morning Routines & Productivity
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Adverbs of frequency (always, usually, sometimes, never)

promptDecks.title: Evening Wind-Down & Work-Life Balance
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Like / don’t like + -ing (I like reading. I don’t like watching TV.)

promptDecks.title: Home & Living Preferences
promptDecks.grammarFocus: There is / There are + opinions (There is a park. It’s good because…)

promptDecks.title: Minimalism vs. Comfort at Home
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Prepositions of place + reasons (The sofa is next to… because…)

promptDecks.title: Food Culture & Personal Taste
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Like / love / hate + noun/gerund (I love spicy food. I hate cooking.)

promptDecks.title: Restaurants & Social Eating
promptDecks.grammarFocus: I would like… / Could I…? + opinions (I would like… / The service is slow.)

promptDecks.title: Money Habits & Spending Priorities
promptDecks.grammarFocus: How much…? / It costs… + comparisons (It’s too expensive. It’s worth it.)

promptDecks.title: Fashion & Identity
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Comparatives (cheaper than, more comfortable than)

promptDecks.title: Weather & Lifestyle Choices
promptDecks.grammarFocus: It is + adjective + for + activity (It’s too cold for walking.)

promptDecks.title: Hobbies & Personal Growth
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Like / enjoy + -ing + because (I enjoy painting because it’s relaxing.)

promptDecks.title: Sports, Health & Competition
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Play / go / do + opinion (I play football. It’s fun because…)

promptDecks.title: City Life vs. Small Town
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Comparatives + reasons (The city is bigger but noisier.)

promptDecks.title: Transport Choices & Sustainability
promptDecks.grammarFocus: By + transport + preference (I go by bike. It’s healthier.)

promptDecks.title: Job Satisfaction & Motivation
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Find + noun + adjective (I find my job stressful.)

promptDecks.title: Emotions & Mental Wellbeing
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Feel + adjective + when (I feel stressed when…)

promptDecks.title: Health Choices & Prevention
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Should / shouldn’t + advice (You should sleep more.)

promptDecks.title: Time Perception & Punctuality
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Be + adjective + about (I’m strict about time.)

promptDecks.title: Shopping Ethics & Consumer Choices
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Try to + verb + because (I try to buy local because…)

promptDecks.title: Healthcare Access & Expectations
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Have to / don’t have to + opinion (I have to pay for medicine.)

promptDecks.title: Travel Mindset & Cultural Curiosity
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Want to / plan to + place (I want to visit Japan.)

promptDecks.title: Social Plans & Boundaries
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Do you want to…? / I’d rather…

promptDecks.title: Navigation & Independence
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Can / can’t + ability (I can read maps. I can’t ask for help.)

promptDecks.title: Learning Styles & Education Memories
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Used to + verb (I used to hate math.)

promptDecks.title: Session 29: Tech Dependence & Digital Habits
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Spend + time + -ing (I spend too much time scrolling.)

promptDecks.title: Session 30: Life Reflections & Future Hopes
promptDecks.grammarFocus: Would like to + verb (I’d like to travel more.)
